author: c05_review
activation: Authorized immediately after reporting final C12 six-file author freeze; preserve C12 while root/peer finish.
canonical_requirement: Develop a theoretical research note: baseline model, existence or optimality argument, comparative statics, counterexample and economic interpretation.
selected_direction: Original repeated collaboration with imperfect public monitoring and a finite, explicitly declared public protocol. Use a small model whose complete public-state value equations, all-state incentives and conditional welfare can be proved and reproduced; choose coherent numerical primitives with a meaningful false claim/counterexample and feasible repair. This is an authored synthetic theory study, not replication of a real empirical paper.
requirements: Design one coherent research brief, original primitives/state/timing/actions/information/resources, baseline theorem and complete proof, global unilateral incentive certificate, a counterexample to an overbroad interpretation, and at least two substantive extensions/sensitivity questions. Do not merely change the numbers in C07/C09 or the chapter12 grant game.

Prefer two public states, binary actions and a genuinely noisy monitoring law. Distinguish all-public-history/randomized deviations from the finite policy class used for mechanism search. Where a finite dynamic-programming inequality proves full best responses, give its bounded-value/tail argument explicitly. Do not treat finite strategy enumeration alone as an all-history proof or claim all-equilibrium uniqueness without proving it.

If comparing candidate protocols or pure stationary policy profiles, enumerate the entire declared class and state its limits. Monitoring/selection/commitment and any restoration/punishment rule must be explicit; preserve off-path incentives and feasibility. Every payment has a payer, ownership, actual prefunding and settlement timing; real resource costs do not disappear in consolidated transfers. A payoff-only effort model may deliberately omit transfers but must say what costs mean.

Supply exact deterministic benchmark inputs and outputs, portable standard-library Python implementation design, README/data dictionary/provenance, manifest and full instructor derivations for every project task. Runtime files follow the existing five downloadable payloads plus projectHTML/checker/source/author record pattern after root design approval. No final files yet.

Include a required actual-paper transfer dossier: choose a primary theoretical paper, identify exact model and theorem, audit a proof and one boundary/counterexample, propose a tractable extension and write a referee report. Supply criteria and an original worked benchmark; do not fabricate external paper inspection, theorem verification or research originality.

Use a100-point evidence-based rubric with clear essential domains, critical proof/incentive/feasibility/integrity errors and complete benchmark answers. External originality/research quality still requires human expert evaluation.

Independently compute all anchors and proof conditions before one-file freeze. Put compact inputs, exact results, method/count and proof routes in this proposal; do not create ancillary computation files for the design stage. Root audits before full authoring.

Reuse accepted C01–C11 and frozen C12 scopes and actual-inspector attribution; retrieve no new sources unless an unresolved claim requires them. No source exam reproduction, unnecessary install/framework, shared/canonical/STATUS/hosting edits, publication or child agents.
